mapper.select: SELECT ws.id AS id, ws.stock_no AS stockNo, m.material_name AS materialName, ws.expiry_date AS expiryDate, ws.qty AS qty FROM warehouse_stock ws JOIN material m ON ws.material_code = m.material_code WHERE ws.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND ws.qty > 0 AND ws.expiry_date < CURDATE()

SELECT ws.id AS id, ws.stock_no AS stockNo, m.material_name AS materialName, ws.expiry_date AS expiryDate, ws.qty AS qty FROM warehouse_stock ws JOIN material m ON ws.material_code = m.material_code WHERE ws.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND ws.qty > 0 AND ws.expiry_date = CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY

SELECT ws.id AS id, ws.stock_no AS stockNo, m.material_name AS materialName, ws.expiry_date AS expiryDate, ws.qty AS qty FROM warehouse_stock ws JOIN material m ON ws.material_code = m.material_code WHERE ws.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND ws.qty > 0 AND ws.expiry_date > CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ws.expiry_date <= CURDATE() + INTERVAL 3 DAY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (category, title, message, target_type, target_id, created_at) VALUES (#{category}, #{title}, #{message}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE branch_code = 1 AND hq_id IS NOT NULL
